verdicts.reason: A is a clean left-aligned stack. Logo, headline, subhead, pills and CTA share one left edge, the hierarchy is clear and the brand circles survive. Its flaws are the tiny pill labels and a somewhat empty right half filled only by the peach circle. B's headline runs almost into the right edge, and the logo, headline and subhead start at slightly different left positions. The CTA floats on the right, cut off from the text column, and the flavour pills sit below it at the bottom, which breaks the reading order. The peach circle is a cramped fragment jammed into the top-right corner.
